item.title: Agent 生态
item.summary: Agent 生态的控制权不在“有多少 Agent”，而在谁能把第三方供给经过标准接入、可信审核、工作入口分发、企业身份授权和可计量运行转成 retained task，并把模型、工具、数据与运行时消费回流到云。MCP/A2A 正降低供给迁移成本，Microsoft、AWS、Google、Anthropic、OpenAI 与 Oracle 分别争夺工作入口、云运行时、协议、开发框架和应用流程；但 GMV、激活、续费、云 attach 和事故全成本仍未公开，当前只能判 pilot，而不能判成熟生态飞轮。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来 12–36 个月，公共协议会继续扩大供给，但价值将向掌握企业工作入口、身份/权限、可信目录、计量交易和生产运行时的平台集中。若平台不能公开 active Agent、retained task、成功任务成本、伙伴收入、云 attach 与事故率，生态仍会停留在目录扩张而不是可持续经营。
synthesis.strategic_summary: Agent 生态的控制权不在“有多少 Agent”，而在谁能把第三方供给经过标准接入、可信审核、工作入口分发、企业身份授权和可计量运行转成 retained task，并把模型、工具、数据与运行时消费回流到云。MCP/A2A 正降低供给迁移成本，Microsoft、AWS、Google、Anthropic、OpenAI 与 Oracle 分别争夺工作入口、云运行时、协议、开发框架和应用流程；但 GMV、激活、续费、云 attach 和事故全成本仍未公开，当前只能判 pilot，而不能判成熟生态飞轮。
synthesis.why_now: MCP 已跨主要平台，A2A Agent 已进入云 Marketplace，企业入口开始提供 Agent Store，且生产客户已同时调用多 Agent、模型、网关、身份和业务系统；与此同时，协议级安全、供应链治理和多云反锁定成为采用约束。
winner_conditions: 一次构建可跨入口复用，同时保留平台原生性能与治理
可信目录把能力、身份、权限、版本、价格和责任边界一起上架
Agent 能在高频工作表面被用户或管理员发现并启用
交易支持订阅、按量与混合计费，且伙伴能够获得可持续收入
运行时提供身份、隔离、网关、记忆、观测、评估与恢复
平台能把 active task 连接到模型、工具、数据和云资源消费
安全审核、事故响应和跨平台迁移成本可被量化

evidence.source_quote: The paper finds current MCP defenses uneven and predominantly tool-centric, with persistent coverage gaps at host orchestration, transport and registry or supply-chain layers.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MCP 防御覆盖分析用于验证 Registry、工具审核和运行时控制是否覆盖主机编排、传输与供应链风险。

evidence.source_quote: When Microsoft validates and approves your app package, your agent is available in the Microsoft Commercial Marketplace and ready for IT enablement. When an IT administrator enables the agent, it appears in the Apps store within Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. It also appears in the Agent Store within Microsoft 365 Copilot. When the agent is deployed by an admin or acquired by a user, it appears as an installed agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft 的个人、组织目录与商业市场分发矩阵说明 Agent 生态的关键是工作入口、管理员启用和审核治理。

evidence.source_quote: "Anthropic is the most committed AI company in the world to the partner ecosystem—and we're putting $100 million behind that this year to prove it. The certification, the co-investment, the dedicated team—this infrastructure is built so that any firm, at any scale, can build a Claude practice. Our partners are instrumental in getting enterprises from proof of concept to production with Claude, and we're making sure they have everything they need to do it."—Steve Corfield, Head of Global Business Development and Partnerships, Anthropic.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic 的伙伴投资、认证、目录与联合市场投入说明模型厂商通过服务生态补足生产交付和客户触达。

evidence.source_quote: AgentCore Registry documents discovery of agents or tools for internal workflows, adding capabilities to customer-facing agents, managing agent sprawl, sharing reusable skills, enforcing curation standards, and synchronizing registry records with live servers.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AgentCore Registry 的发现、复用、治理和同步用例说明企业内部 Agent 生态需要目录和质量控制，而非仅有开放上架。

evidence.source_quote: Docker reported a survey of more than 800 developers and decision makers: 46% used four to six models while 2% used one model, 79% operated agents in at least two environments, 48% named multi-component operational complexity as the largest challenge and 43% cited increased security exposure from orchestration sprawl. These are vendor-reported estimates.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Docker 的 800+ 调查用于观察企业多供应商与反锁定偏好；属于厂商研究，只作 reported estimate。

evidence.source_quote: Anthropic reported more than 10,000 active public MCP servers, adoption by ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and VS Code, deployment support from AWS, Google Cloud and Azure, a Claude directory with more than 75 connectors, an official Registry, and more than 97 million monthly Python and TypeScript SDK downloads.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MCP 的跨平台采用、连接器目录、Registry 和 SDK 下载量用于验证开放协议是否降低多平台供给成本。

evidence.source_quote: The paper identifies protocol-level MCP weaknesses: absence of capability attestation, server-side prompt injection and implicit trust propagation in multi-server configurations. Its MCPBench framework measures protocol-specific attack surfaces.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MCP 协议安全分析用于检验开放连接协议能否在缺少能力证明和来源认证时安全扩大供给。

evidence.source_quote: These primitives include tool use via MCP ⁠ (opens in a new window) , progressive disclosure via skills ⁠ (opens in a new window) , custom instructions via AGENTS.md ⁠ (opens in a new window) , code execution using the shell ⁠ (opens in a new window) tool, file edits using the apply patch ⁠ (opens in a new window) tool, and more. The harness will continue to incorporate new agentic patterns and primitives over time, so developers can spend less time on core infrastructure updates and more time on the domain-specific logic that makes their agents useful.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: OpenAI 把 MCP、Skill、沙箱与跨云存储接入统一到 Agents SDK，说明开发标准和运行时决定第三方供给能否导入平台。

evidence.source_quote: IT Pro reported OX Security's claim of more than 30 responsible disclosures and 10 Critical or High CVEs during MCP supply-chain research. This is reported research, not an independently audited ecosystem incident count.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 专业媒体转述安全研究和披露规模，作为开放 Agent 工具链供应链风险的外部反证。

evidence.source_quote: Google Cloud Marketplace requires an A2A Agent Card, review and integration before publication; published agents can be added to Gemini Enterprise, and sellers may use free, subscription, usage-based or combined pricing.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google Cloud Marketplace 把 A2A Agent Card、Gemini Enterprise 分发、审核与多种计费绑定，展示生态交易和云回流机制。

evidence.source_quote: The agent also connects to third-party systems — such as partner calendar APIs — to check availability and avoid scheduling conflicts. By cross-referencing data from both the Celonis environment and external systems, the agent autonomously identifies the optimal time slot and schedules the appointment, then writes the outcome back into Celonis via an action flow.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Celonis 生产案例展示第三方 MCP 工具、伙伴系统和 AWS AgentCore 如何共同完成跨企业流程并把结果写回。

evidence.source_quote: We’re now adding connectors and an MCP app from new partners. The new connectors give direct, real-time access to market and research data, while the MCP app surfaces custom, interactive UI directly within Claude.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Claude 金融 Agent 把模板、插件、Office 入口、数据伙伴与托管运行组合，展示垂直生态的供给和分发结构。

evidence.source_quote: AWS Marketplace now offers Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server support and streamlined deployment for third-party AI agents and tools built for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. The new capabilities accelerate deployment by pre-populating required environment variables in the AgentCore console and AWS CLI instructions in AWS Marketplace. Customers can now also procure and deploy A2A servers on AgentCore Runtime through AWS Marketplace, making it easier for them to leverage AI agents from AWS Partners. The improvements reduce deployment complexity by leveraging vendor-defined launch configurations while adding protocol flexibility to meet diverse customer needs. AWS Partners can now offer A2A servers in addition to MCP servers and AI agents using AgentCore Runtime containers in the AWS Marketplace Management Portal. To accelerate customer onboarding, AWS Partners can define required environment variables for AgentCore Runtime supported products so that customers can quickly get started. AWS Partners can also enable free pricing for API-based SaaS products. These capabilities provide AWS Partners with the flexibility to bring new products to market and implement pricing strategies that align with their business models and customers’ needs. Customers can learn more in the buyer guide and start exploring AI agent solutions in AWS Marketplace on the solutions page . For AWS Partners interes
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS Marketplace 同时承载 A2A、MCP 和 AgentCore 部署，并允许伙伴设定价格，展示供给上架到云消耗的闭环。

evidence.source_quote: Druva reported a production system coordinating eight to ten specialized agents on AgentCore. It reported more than 17,500 AI conversations across more than 3,000 users in four months, 68% of customer issues resolved through agent workflows and 58% faster resolution when support teams assisted.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Druva 在生产中编排 8–10 个专用 Agent，并把身份、网关、模型和运行时消费导向 AWS，且披露采用和结果。

evidence.source_quote: Microsoft reported a growing Copilot agent ecosystem with Adobe, Asana, Jira, LexisNexis, SAP, ServiceNow, Snowflake and Workday building connected agents; agent users doubled quarter over quarter, KPMG used Agent Framework in audit, and Microsoft said these production deployments were driving Azure growth.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 微软财报把 ISV Agent 生态、Agent 用户增长、客户工作流和 Azure 增长连接起来，是生态向云资源回流的财务级方向证据。

evidence.source_quote: The MIT-led Index reviewed 30 prominent agents: 20 supported MCP, 23 were fully closed, 135 of 240 safety-related fields lacked public information, only four had agent-specific system cards, and evaluation was fragmented across model, orchestration, tool and deployment owners.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MIT Agent Index 对生态碎片化、评估不足和基础模型集中度的研究限制平台供给数量等于健康生态的判断。

evidence.source_quote: Oracle describes a curated collection of partner-built agents native to Fusion Applications. Each agent undergoes a 21-point enterprise-readiness inspection, can connect with third-party systems, and is distributed through certified partners.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Oracle 官方 Marketplace 简报用于检验应用套件厂商如何把认证伙伴 Agent 直接嵌入 Fusion 工作流和 OCI 消耗。
